cases.description: A cancelled question preserves a falsy application reason, frees its slot, and completes a later question without invoking the cancelled success path.

files.questions.cjs: const fs=require('node:fs');const {PassThrough}=require('stream');const {createInterface}=require('readline/promises');module.exports=async function(){const input=new PassThrough();const rl=createInterface({input,terminal:false});const control=new AbortController();const pending=rl.question('cancel?',{signal:control.signal}).then(()=>fs.writeFileSync('unexpected.txt','wrong success'));control.abort(false);try{await pending;throw Error('missing rejection');}catch(error){if(error.code!=='ABORT_ERR'||error.cause!==false)throw error;}const next=rl.question('next?');input.write('accepted\n');const answer=await next;rl.close();fs.writeFileSync('answer.txt',answer+'\n');return answer;};
